plain: Shown or stated outwardly, though maybe not the real reason.

webster.text: That may be shown; proper or intended to be shown.

example.quote: Not a single man of those who assume it, is chosen by us; or is subject to our control or influence; but, on the contrary, they are all of them exempt from the operation of such laws, and an American revenue, if not diverted from the ostensible purposes for which it is raised, would actually lighten their own burdens in proportion, as they increase ours.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
